faq: Do you need my payment provider login?
No. You connect the provider inside your own store, and we guide you through it. Where staff access is needed to check settings, we ask for limited access, never your password or card details.
Can you move my existing Stripe or PayPal account?
Yes, you can usually keep the same account and connect it to the new store. Saved cards stay with the provider and cannot be moved by us, so recurring customers may need to enter details again.
Will taxes be set up correctly?

We configure tax in line with the settings you give us and the platform's tools, then test with sample addresses. Tax law is your responsibility, so please check with an accountant for your situation.
We can connect carriers the platform supports, such as USPS, UPS, DHL or Royal Mail where available. Live rates depend on your plan with the platform and your carrier account, which you hold.

desc:
Payments, tax and shipping setup after migration is what turns a copied catalog into a store that can take money and send parcels. Ecom Swift LLC configures your payment methods, tax rules and shipping rates in your own account, then tests a full checkout.

## What is payments, tax and shipping setup?

It is the configuration that decides what a customer pays and how the order reaches them. Payments cover the methods offered at checkout, such as cards and wallets. Tax covers which rates apply in which places. Shipping covers zones, rates, free-delivery rules and carriers.

These settings are stored per store and do not come across in a product export. After a platform move, they must be rebuilt and checked.

## Why checkout settings need care

Customers meet these settings at the last step, when they are most sensitive to surprises. A shipping price that appears only at the end sends many people away. A wrong tax amount can cause a dispute or leave you out of pocket. A payment method that fails without an error message produces silent lost orders.

Mistakes here also cost real money after the sale. If a rate is set too low, you pay the difference on every parcel. If tax is missing, you may owe it from your own margin.

## How it affects conversion and margin

Checkout is where visitors become buyers, so clarity matters. Showing the right delivery options, a clear total and familiar payment choices removes hesitation. Free-shipping thresholds can lift the size of a basket, because shoppers add an item to reach them.

On the margin side, correct rates mean your shipping income and costs roughly match. Weight-based or carrier-based rates reflect what you really pay. Tax settings that match where you sell keep your accounts clean.

## What a complete setup includes

- Your payment provider connected through your own account.
- Extra payment methods enabled where they suit your customers.
- Shipping zones that match the regions you serve.
- Flat, weight-based, price-based or live carrier rates, depending on your plan.
- Free shipping rules and minimum order thresholds.
- Tax settings for each country or region where you sell.
- Local pickup or local delivery where you offer it.
- Duties and international tax settings for cross-border orders.
- Order confirmation and shipping emails checked for correct totals.
- Gift card and discount code behavior tested.
- A shipping label tool connected, in the larger package.

## What we do

We read your old store's shipping zones, rates, tax settings and payment setup, and write them down in a simple table. You tell us what should stay and what should change. We then build the same structure on the new store.

Payment providers are connected using your own provider account, so funds go straight to you. Where an existing provider account can be linked to the new platform, we guide the connection. We then place test orders: a small domestic order, one that triggers free shipping, one to another region and one with a discount code. Each result is compared with the figure we expect.

The Basic, Standard and Premium packages differ in the number of providers, zones and tax regions, and in whether live carrier rates, pickup, duties and a written test script are included.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep your real shipping costs to hand when we set rates.
- Check your provider account is verified before launch.
- Test with a small order and a refund.
- Confirm your tax registration with an accountant.
- Show delivery estimates on the product page.

**Avoid:**
- Hiding shipping costs until the final step.
- Setting rates from guesswork.
- Enabling every payment method without a reason.
- Forgetting international orders in the zone list.
- Going live before a test order has completed.

## Who this is for

An owner who has moved the products but cannot yet take an order. A seller who ships abroad and needs duties and taxes to behave. A local business that wants pickup and delivery options next to postal shipping.

## What we need from you

Send us your current shipping rates and zones, the payment providers you want to use and the countries where you collect tax. Give us staff or collaborator access to the new store.

We do not need your payment provider login or your passwords. You connect the provider yourself in a short guided step, and we handle everything around it.
